title: Video
description: Video content with creator information, duration, engagement metrics (views, likes, dislikes, comments), category, tags, and publication date. Used for video sharing platforms, content management systems, and media libraries.

creator.description: Full name of the video creator or channel

creator_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user or channel who created the video

views.description: Total number of times the video has been viewed

likes.description: Number of likes or positive reactions

dislikes.description: Number of dislikes or negative reactions

comments_count.description: Total number of comments on the video

category.description: Video category (e.g., Entertainment, Education, Gaming, Music, Sports)

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization and search

thumbnail.description: URL to the video thumbnail image

url.description: URL to watch or download the video

published_at.description: Timestamp when the video was published
